decisions.story_title: Nippon T-Rex / Kyokuto Kaihatsu Kogyo Ransomware Incident
decisions.reason: Real ransomware incident: INC Ransom posted Kyokuto Kaihatsu Kogyo on their leak site July 17; subsidiary Nippon T-Rex reported unauthorized access Sept 8, system outage ongoing. Defense contractor subsidiary, substantive incident.

decisions.story_title: Hackers Exploit Tencent Sogou Input Method Flaw to Deploy GrayRabbit Malware
decisions.reason: Active exploitation of Tencent Sogou Input Method for Windows to deploy GrayRabbit malware. Real campaign with malware payload, not just a vuln disclosure.

decisions.story_title: DFIR Field Notes: Impacket Lateral Movement via Remote Registry
decisions.reason: Detailed DFIR walkthrough of real incident: AV alert (Behavior:Win32/RegDump.SA) leading to discovery of Impacket secretsdump-style lateral movement via Remote Registry. Practical tradecraft and detection guidance.
